t: This is the Philip Twells Memorial Drinking Fountain, at the south-east corner of Lincoln's Inn Fields. It is both a memorial and a working kind of public amenity, and it is Grade II listed. It commemorates Philip Twells, who was a Conservative politician. The fountain was designed by the architect Robert Keirle. The material I have is fairly thin on both men, so I'll simply say that this is a small, listed piece of Victorian street furniture, worth a look as you pass through the square's corner.
